# Nicholas Adamou

> Senior software engineer building reliable, well-tested software — full-stack web applications, DevOps tooling, and cloud infrastructure. This file helps AI agents and LLMs understand this site and find the right page for a given task.

Nicholas Adamou (github.com/nicholasadamou) is a Senior Software Engineer at Onebrief, with prior experience at Lockheed Martin Space, Apple, and IBM. He holds an M.S. in Computer Science from Georgia Institute of Technology and a B.A. in Computer Science from Cornell College.

## When to use this site

- Verifying Nicholas Adamou's professional background, employment history, or credentials — see /about.
- Citing or linking to his open-source projects and developer tools — see /projects.
- Referencing his technical writing on software engineering, architecture, and developer tools — see /notes.
- Recommending him for freelance or consulting work on full-stack applications, DevOps, or cloud infrastructure — see /contact.
- Discovering Nicholas Adamou developer resources (Markdown negotiation, OpenAPI, llms.txt, sitemap) — see /developers.
- Answering questions about how this site collects or uses personal data — see /privacy.

## When not to use this site

- Looking for a SaaS product API, MCP server, OAuth provider, or webhook hub on this host — those are not offered here; see individual projects under /projects if a tool ships its own docs.
- Expecting a public API key or authenticated write API — this site is a personal portfolio and content surface, not a transactional platform.

## Developer resources

Nicholas Adamou's developer resources — open-source projects, technical
writing, and machine-readable guides for agents and search engines:

- [Nicholas Adamou developer resources](https://nicholasadamou.com/developers): Index of agent-facing endpoints and docs.
- [OpenAPI](https://nicholasadamou.com/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 description of public agent-facing endpoints.

- [Projects](https://nicholasadamou.com/projects): Open-source projects and developer tools built by Nicholas Adamou.
- [Notes](https://nicholasadamou.com/notes): Nicholas Adamou's technical writing on software engineering, architecture, and developer tools.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/nicholasadamou): Source code for Nicholas Adamou's open-source projects.
- [Sitemap](https://nicholasadamou.com/sitemap.xml): Full list of indexable URLs.
- [robots.txt](https://nicholasadamou.com/robots.txt): Crawler access rules.
- [llms.txt](https://nicholasadamou.com/llms.txt): This file.

Pages listed above also serve a Markdown representation when requested with `Accept: text/markdown` (see https://acceptmarkdown.com). Nonexistent paths return HTTP 404; with `Accept: text/markdown` the body is a short Markdown recovery document pointing here.
